Protected owned synthetic trees snapshot names, directory/file attributes, byte sizes/SHA256 and modification ticks on success/failure, absent/malformed config, unavailable output, collisions/duplicate names/reserved jobs, scan failures, FFREPORT set and rejected doctor/manifest combinations. Unit mocks forbid transient writer/native/prompt boundaries. Preview reports separate Plans, without produced job/savings claims.

Defaults/config/run precedence, optional saved rename/skip, explicit empty/relative/provider/wildcard/bad enum and configured CRF bounds; actual unsupported CRF including ASCII/U+2013/U+2014/U+2015 rejected before application writes. Actual override of offline saved output and collision override preserve config SHA/unknown keys. Public quality switch not added. Explicit output succeeds with a blank absent-config Windows default on preview/doctor/conversion; blank unoverridden default and malformed existing config fail unchanged.

Real Get-Help examples retrieved and safely parsed into token arrays, placeholder paths mapped to owned fixtures and all three examples executed on each host. Actual PS1/BAT unattended options after positional inputs exit without menu/pause/stdin. Existing launcher/Exit suites retained.
